sessionContext: Use only for the repository and pull request frozen when this profile was activated.
Read pull-request status before changing code or responding to review.

Inspect all review threads with: gh api graphql --paginate --slurp -f 'query=<ReviewThreads query>' -f owner=<owner> -f repo=<repo> -F pr=<number>. The exact ReviewThreads query is in the reviewed request materializer.

Every reply must begin with _Replying as **Codex**. followed by a blank line. Run one gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/pulls/<pr>/comments/<comment-id>/replies command per comment, each with -f body='_Replying as **Codex**.

<reply>' or -F body=@<workspace-root reply-file> whose first bytes are that prefix. You may place multiple such commands in one ordinary shell sequence; do not use command substitution.

Resolve addressed threads with the reviewed ResolveReviewThread GraphQL mutation. You may resolve one thread per call or use the reviewed batch form with one PRRT variable per thread; every mutation in the batch must carry clientMutationTag=<owner>/<repo>#<pr>.

After replying to or resolving threads, tell the user which threads were replied to or resolved and include the resulting comment or thread links. Reading threads alone does not require a user-facing report.
